answer: A sybil-resistant economy can anchor each agent's identity in a verifiable-work kernel: before an agent may transact, it must present signed proof of sustained useful work, not merely a fresh keypair. Activity is sampled as a pulse of attestations from peers, so an identity that appears only to spam shows a flat line. An agent whose conduct sinks to its nadir of trust forfeits staked reputation and must re-earn standing through real work, making each fake identity expensive to create and cheap to expose.
